summary: Marriage consent established through solemnization; Exception 2 to IPC s.375 applicable; no prima facie case under IPC s.376; SIT investigation confirmed voluntary marriage; charges under s.363/366 rejected; respondent's 164 statement contradicted by court records; failure to contest appeal reflects weak case; quashing appropriate to prevent misuse of process.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; FIR No. 148 of 2022 and all consequential proceedings quashed; High Court order set aside.
